name: p_sshi_full_bridge_zener_clamp
rationale: The previous best design 'p_sshi_full_bridge' delivered sufficient power to meet vout_min and startup requirements but failed vout_max because the output was unregulated. I am adding a voltage clamp consisting of a Zener diode (DZ33) and a chain of four silicon diodes (DSI) to limit the output voltage to approximately 5.3V (3.3V + 4 * 0.5V). The Zener cathode is connected to the 'out' node to ensure conduction only when the voltage exceeds the threshold. This should satisfy vout_max while maintaining the power delivery of the full-bridge SSHI topology.
